Q sensitivity grows with net charge movement. Final Q error adds0.044115pp over0.03Ah; the900s anchor adds5.393661pp under the same follow-up charge.
Only Q and entering SOC change direct propagated SOC; nuisance effects through future voltage corrections remain unmeasured.
